vasawkara ma (tekst vasawkaram a) me pra.s: vazawkAra mA (tekzt vazawkAram A) me pra vAN mo ahaM tvAM bfhatA mana upahvaye

vasaw te pusan asmin sutO (aVP। pusan as.h: वषट् ते पूषन्न् अस्मिन् सूतौ (AVP। पूषन्न् अस्यै सुवृक्तिम्)
vasaw te pusan asmin sutO (aVP। pusan as.s: vazaw te pUzann asmin sUtO (AVP। pUzann asyE suvfktim)

vasaw te visRav(Ks.ap। visRa) asa a kfRo.s: vazaw te vizRav(KS.Ap। vizRa) Asa A kfRomi

vasantasyahan devayajyaya tejasvan payas.s: vasantasyAhaM devayajyayA tejasvAn payasvAn (KS.Ap। devayajyayorjasvAn) BUyAsam
